content.passage: A university trialled later library opening during exams. Attendance after 8 pm was highest from Monday to Thursday, while Friday demand remained low. Students mainly used quiet study areas rather than borrowing services.
content.question: Which statements are supported?

options.A: Late-night attendance was strongest early in the working week.
options.C: Quiet study areas were heavily used.
options.D: Borrowing services were the main reason students stayed late.
